lines.4: 「Don't worry. No one's found out about the deserted island.」
lines.6: 「Man, she calls over every little thing.」
lines.8: Three shadows burst out of the closet.
lines.9: 「Huff, huff... it was cramped in there... I'm drenched in sweat.」
lines.10: 「We had it worse than you! You hogged the entire upper space! Why the hell did I have to be squashed up against Subaru!?」
lines.11: 「That's my line, damn it. It's hot...」
lines.15: 「Hey, what's this about a deserted island?」
lines.17: 「I-I have no idea what you could possibly mean.」
lines.18: 「Let me guess. You spent the night on a deserted island alone with a girl, right?」
lines.19: 「What!? You really went and lived out my fantasy scenario!!」
lines.22: 「What the hell does that mean? Spill it, asshole!」
lines.23: 「Ghh, stop! Don't shake me by the neck.」
lines.24: 「Did you suck the blood out of a snakebite!?」
lines.25: 「I have no idea what you're talking about!」
lines.27: I couldn't let them start spreading wild rumors.
lines.28: If I made it clear I was serious, these guys would keep their word.
lines.29: 「Not a word to anyone. I need a real "promise" on this.」
lines.33: 「Oh-ho. One night and two days on a deserted island with Konoe, huh?」
lines.34: 「Must be nice, you lucky bastard! Huh!? Well!?」
lines.35: 「Ow, ow! Quit putting me in a joint lock!!」
lines.36: 「So, kiddo, are you going to start dating Konoe?」
lines.38: 「Hah! Couples who get together under unusual circumstances never last! There was a movie about that, remember!!」
lines.40: What Crab had just said got under my skin.
lines.41: Wait, if it got under my skin... does that mean I...?
lines.42: Maybe I really was starting to like Konoe.
lines.43: ...That really was an unusual situation back then.
lines.44: Maybe I should try a fresh start.
lines.45: Most of all, I wanted to hang out with her again.
lines.47: 「All right, let's draw all over his face with a permanent marker.」
lines.49: 「You stick up for Leo way too much, Subaru!」
lines.52: 「If you feel bad, introduce me to a girl!」
lines.54: 「Shut up, crustacean! You introduce me to one of your friends too!」
lines.58: 「He said he wants to make easy money in the future, you see.」
lines.59: Good. They were keeping their promise to stay quiet.
lines.60: 「Then he needs to be properly disciplined.」
lines.62: 「Let me join you. I know a good joint lock.」
lines.64: Couldn't you have covered it up... some other way?
